```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

Main-text figures are in `paper_figures.Rmd`.

Supplementary Figure 1 shows the sequencing controls as sequenced. Two samples that had been typed as positive standards did not match the ZymoBIOMICS mix, and those rows were removed from the metadata. They are not in this file. The noise found in the two matched positive standards is subtracted from every remaining sample by `decontaminate_metaphlan.R`, and every figure from Supplementary Figure 2 on, like every main-text figure, uses that transformed table. Positive and negative sequencing controls are excluded from every analysis figure; the three Tel Megiddo swabs typed `control` are touched-rock swabs and stay in.

Material colors stay the same wherever a figure encodes material: rock/stone `#009E73`, granite `#CC79A7`, metal `#8C510A`, marble `#E69F00`, others `#0072B2`. A focal monument-material group keeps the color of its material. This file does not use those fills for library size, because file size is not a material. Dropped samples stay red, as in the sequencing-size scatter from the analysis notebook.

Each new chunk is preceded by a short explanation of what that panel shows and what was changed from the analysis notebook.

```{r libraries}

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- basename(as.character(x))
  x <- str_remove(x, "\\.(fastq|fq)(\\.gz)?$")
  x <- str_remove(x, "_R[12](_001)?$")
  x <- str_remove(x, "_S[0-9]+.*$")
  x
}

# Figure theme, Jaccard NMDS, Mann-Whitney brackets, and PNG/PDF savers.
FIG_FONT <- "Helvetica"
PRINT_WIDTH_IN <- 180 / 25.4     # 7.09 in, the maximum width allowed
PRINT_MAX_HEIGHT_IN <- 10.6      # A4 is 11.69 in; leaves room for a page margin
PRINT_DPI <- 600
CHECK_DPI <- 300

set_figure_mode <- function(mode = c("check", "print")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  sizes <- switch(
    mode,
    check = list(
      FIG_BASE_SIZE = 15, FIG_TITLE_SIZE = 17, FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE = 16,
      FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE = 13, FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE = 14, FIG_TAG_SIZE = 24,
      FIG_SMALL_TEXT_SIZE = 12, FIG_GEOM = 1
    ),
    print = list(
      FIG_BASE_SIZE = 7, FIG_TITLE_SIZE = 7, FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE = 7,
      FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE = 6, FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE = 7, FIG_TAG_SIZE = 8,
      FIG_SMALL_TEXT_SIZE = 6, FIG_GEOM = 0.45
    )
  )
  assign("FIG_MODE", mode, envir = globalenv())
  for (nm in names(sizes)) assign(nm, sizes[[nm]], envir = globalenv())
  invisible(mode)
}
set_figure_mode("check")

is_print <- function() identical(FIG_MODE, "print")
pt_to_mm <- function(pt) pt / ggplot2::.pt
gs <- function(x) x * FIG_GEOM          # point sizes and line widths
# In print mode every size that is written in inches for the check figures is scaled down
# by the same ratio as the text (7 pt / 15 pt).
fs <- function(x) x * FIG_BASE_SIZE / 15
# Choose a value by mode.
by_mode <- function(check, print) if (is_print()) print else check

# Axis titles sit a few points from the tick labels, never far away.
paper_theme <- function(base_size = FIG_BASE_SIZE, angle_x = TRUE) {
  m <- base_size / 15   # margins scale with the text
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_TITLE_SIZE, margin = margin(t = 10 * m, b = 6 * m)),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, margin = margin(b = 4 * m)),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_TAG_SIZE),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE, margin = margin(t = 5 * m)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE, margin = margin(r = 5 * m)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.x = if (angle_x) {
        element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, colour = "black")
      } else {
        element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.95, colour = "black")
      },
      axis.ticks.length = unit(4 * m, "pt"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = gs(0.5)),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = gs(0.5)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.55 * m, "cm"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size),
      plot.margin = margin(8 * m, 14 * m, 8 * m, 8 * m)
    )
}

paper_theme_continuous <- function(base_size = FIG_BASE_SIZE) {
  paper_theme(base_size, angle_x = FALSE)
}

# Theme for panels with many categorical tick labels that stay upright.
paper_theme_upright <- function(base_size = FIG_BASE_SIZE) {
  paper_theme(base_size, angle_x = FALSE)
}

# Blank theme for Venn diagrams, with the same text sizes.
venn_theme <- function() {
  theme_void(base_size = FIG_BASE_SIZE, base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = FIG_TITLE_SIZE),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_TAG_SIZE),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE),
      legend.key.height = unit(by_mode(0.8, 0.35), "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(by_mode(0.5, 0.25), "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(by_mode(8, 3), by_mode(14, 5), by_mode(8, 3), by_mode(8, 3))
    )
}

# Axis, legend, and title text. Accented names are kept in the metadata and
# reduced here, because the figure device prints a missing glyph as <U+XXXX>.
plot_label <- function(x) {
  y <- as.character(x)
  ok <- !is.na(y)
  y[ok] <- stringi::stri_trans_general(y[ok], "Latin-ASCII")
  y[ok] <- str_replace_all(y[ok], "\u00b2", "2")
  y[ok] <- str_replace_all(y[ok], "\u00b3", "3")
  bad <- y[ok & grepl("[^\x01-\x7F]", y)]
  if (length(bad) > 0) {
    stop("A plot label still contains a character the figure device cannot draw: ", paste(unique(bad), collapse = " | "))
  }
  y
}

figure_text <- function(x, depth = 0L) {
  if (is.null(x) || depth > 40L) return(character())
  if (inherits(x, "ggplot")) x <- ggplotGrob(x)
  out <- character()
  lab <- x$label
  if (is.expression(lab) || is.language(lab) || is.symbol(lab)) lab <- as.character(lab)
  if (is.character(lab)) out <- c(out, lab)
  if (!is.null(x$children)) out <- c(out, unlist(lapply(x$children, figure_text, depth + 1L), use.names = FALSE))
  if (!is.null(x$grobs)) out <- c(out, unlist(lapply(x$grobs, figure_text, depth + 1L), use.names = FALSE))
  out
}

save_figure <- function(filename, plot, ...) {
  labels <- figure_text(plot)
  bad <- labels[grepl("[^\x01-\x7F]|<U\\+", labels)]
  if (length(bad) > 0) {
    stop("Figure text is not plain ASCII:\n", paste(unique(bad), collapse = "\n"))
  }
  ggsave(filename, plot, ...)
}

# Check mode: save one panel as a PNG inside the figure's own folder. In print mode this
# does nothing, so the same chunk can be run in both modes. Returns the path or NULL.
save_panel <- function(plot, figure_dir, file_name, width, height, dpi = CHECK_DPI) {
  if (is_print()) return(invisible(NULL))
  dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(file_name, ".png"))
  save_figure(path, plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  invisible(path)
}

# Each panel is wrapped as an independent block, so panels are not aligned to each other
# and no axis title is pushed away from its axis by a neighbour's tick labels.
blk <- function(p) patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p)

# vegan permutation tests report p = (d+1)/(N+1). With N = 999 the smallest value is
# 0.001, which means none of the permutations was as extreme as the observed statistic.
perm_p_text <- function(p, nperm = 999L) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)[[1]]
  floor_p <- 1 / (as.numeric(nperm)[[1]] + 1)
  if (is.finite(p) && p <= floor_p + 1e-12) {
    sprintf("p < %.3g", floor_p)
  } else {
    sprintf("p = %.3g", p)
  }
}

# Jaccard presence-absence distances, PERMANOVA, and 2-D NMDS. Taxa found in
# only one sample are dropped: they inflate Jaccard toward 1 and make 2-D NMDS
# degenerate. Samples that then have no remaining taxa are dropped from the
# distance matrix. NMDS has no percent-explained axes; stress is reported instead.
jaccard_beta <- function(mat, group, nperm = 999L, seed = 123L, trymax = 200L, min_occupancy = 2L) {
  if (is.null(rownames(mat))) rownames(mat) <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(mat)))
  pa <- (mat > 0) * 1
  storage.mode(pa) <- "numeric"
  rownames(pa) <- rownames(mat)
  if (min_occupancy > 1L && ncol(pa) > 0) {
    pa <- pa[, colSums(pa) >= min_occupancy, drop = FALSE]
  }
  keep <- rowSums(pa) > 0
  dropped_samples <- rownames(pa)[!keep]
  pa <- pa[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  group <- group[keep]
  d <- vegan::vegdist(pa, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
  grp <- data.frame(focal_group = group)
  set.seed(seed)
  permanova <- vegan::adonis2(d ~ focal_group, data = grp, permutations = nperm)
  set.seed(seed)
  nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(d, k = 2, trymax = trymax, trace = FALSE)
  scores <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
  names(scores) <- c("NMDS1", "NMDS2")
  rownames(scores) <- rownames(pa)
  list(
    dist = d, permanova = permanova, nmds = nmds, scores = scores, stress = nmds$stress,
    dropped_samples = dropped_samples, n_samples = nrow(pa), n_taxa = ncol(pa)
  )
}

# Pairwise Mann-Whitney (Wilcoxon) tests with BH adjustment.
pairwise_mannwhitney <- function(x, g, p_adjust = "BH") {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  lv <- levels(g)
  if (length(lv) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(group1 = character(), group2 = character(), p_raw = double(), p_adj = double(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  group1 <- character()
  group2 <- character()
  p_raw <- double()
  for (i in seq_len(length(lv) - 1L)) {
    for (j in (i + 1L):length(lv)) {
      xi <- x[g == lv[i] & is.finite(x)]
      xj <- x[g == lv[j] & is.finite(x)]
      p <- if (length(xi) < 2L || length(xj) < 2L) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        stats::wilcox.test(xi, xj, exact = FALSE)$p.value
      }
      group1 <- c(group1, lv[i])
      group2 <- c(group2, lv[j])
      p_raw <- c(p_raw, p)
    }
  }
  data.frame(group1 = group1, group2 = group2, p_raw = p_raw, p_adj = stats::p.adjust(p_raw, method = p_adjust), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

mw_p_text <- function(p) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)[[1]]
  if (!is.finite(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3g", p)
}

# Square brackets for BH-significant pairwise Mann-Whitney tests.
mw_bracket_data <- function(y, group, pw) {
  sig <- pw[is.finite(pw$p_adj) & pw$p_adj < 0.05, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(sig)) return(sig)
  lv <- levels(droplevels(factor(group)))
  sig$i1 <- match(sig$group1, lv)
  sig$i2 <- match(sig$group2, lv)
  sig <- sig[order(sig$i2 - sig$i1, sig$i1), , drop = FALSE]
  ymax <- max(y[is.finite(y)], na.rm = TRUE)
  ymin <- min(y[is.finite(y)], na.rm = TRUE)
  rng <- ymax - ymin
  if (!is.finite(rng) || rng <= 0) rng <- max(abs(ymax), 1)
  sig$label <- vapply(sig$p_adj, mw_p_text, character(1))
  sig$y.position <- ymax + rng * 0.12 * seq_len(nrow(sig))
  sig
}

mw_kw_subtitle <- function(kw_p, pw) {
  sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g", kw_p)
}

# Print mode: save one A4-portrait page as PDF (vector) and PNG (600 dpi). In check mode
# this does nothing. The page must be at most 180 mm wide and must fit A4 portrait.
save_page <- function(plot, figure_dir, name, height, width = PRINT_WIDTH_IN) {
  if (!is_print()) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (width > PRINT_WIDTH_IN + 1e-6) stop(name, ": wider than 180 mm (", round(width * 25.4), " mm).")
  if (height > PRINT_MAX_HEIGHT_IN + 1e-6) stop(name, ": taller than the A4 page allows (", round(height, 2), " in).")
  dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  pdf_path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf"))
  png_path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".png"))
  save_figure(pdf_path, plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", device = grDevices::pdf, family = FIG_FONT)
  save_figure(png_path, plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = PRINT_DPI, bg = "white")
  invisible(png_path)
}

# Named genera from Supplementary Table S7 (`input/Literature_Microorganism.csv`).
# Unresolved genus cells and the order Oscillatoriales are left out. Cutibacterium
# is not on the current table. `Candidatus` names keep the MetaPhlAn underscore.
literature_genera_from_sheet <- function(path) {
  loc <- readr::locale(encoding = "latin1")
  headed <- readr::read_csv(path, skip = 1, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = loc)
  if ("Genus" %in% names(headed)) {
    sheet <- readr::read_csv(path, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = loc)
  } else {
    sheet <- readr::read_csv(
      path, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = loc,
      col_names = c(
        "Domain", "Phylum", "Genus", "Species", "Monument / site", "Material",
        "Observed effect", "Proposed mechanism", "Evidence grade",
        "Evidence type", "References"
      )
    )
  }
  genus_cells <- sheet$Genus
  if ("Validation status" %in% names(sheet)) {
    status <- sheet[["Validation status"]]
    status[is.na(status)] <- ""
    genus_cells <- genus_cells[!stringr::str_detect(status, stringr::regex("NOT recommended", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  }
  parsed <- lapply(genus_cells, function(cell) {
    if (is.na(cell) || !nzchar(as.character(cell))) return(character())
    cell <- stringr::str_replace_all(as.character(cell), "[^A-Za-z0-9 ;/._-]", " ")
    cell <- stringr::str_squish(cell)
    if (stringr::str_detect(cell, stringr::regex("^(not resolved|unresolved|copper-resistant)", ignore_case = TRUE))) {
      return(character())
    }
    cell <- stringr::str_replace(cell, stringr::regex("also deterioration-associated Bryobacter.*$", ignore_case = TRUE), "")
    cell <- stringr::str_replace_all(cell, stringr::regex("-type AOA|-related AOA", ignore_case = TRUE), "")
    parts <- stringr::str_trim(unlist(stringr::str_split(cell, "[;/]")))
    parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
    unlist(lapply(parts, function(genus_name) {
      genus_name <- stringr::str_replace(genus_name, "^Ca\\.\\s*", "Candidatus ")
      genus_name <- stringr::str_replace(genus_name, "^Candidatus\\s+", "Candidatus_")
      genus_name <- stringr::str_replace_all(genus_name, " ", "_")
      if (stringr::str_detect(genus_name, stringr::regex("AOA|resolved", ignore_case = TRUE))) return(character())
      if (!stringr::str_detect(genus_name, "^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")) return(character())
      if (genus_name == "Oscillatoriales") return(character())
      genus_name
    }))
  })
  unique(unlist(parsed))
}

terminal_rank <- function(clade_name) {
  str_extract(str_extract(clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^[kpcofgst]__")
}

normalize_material <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    is.na(x) | x == "" ~ "Unknown",
    x %in% c("rock", "stone", "rock/stone") ~ "rock/stone",
    x == "granite" ~ "granite",
    x == "marble" ~ "marble",
    x %in% c("metal", "bronze", "steel", "gold") ~ "metal",
    TRUE ~ "others"
  )
}

```

All analysis figures use a transformed MetaPhlAn table. `decontaminate_metaphlan.R` builds the noise list from the two positive standards whose profiles matched the ZymoBIOMICS mix: `BC-0247288828` (Soldier's National Monument) and `BC-0302366907` (Orpheus). Every species those two standards contain that is not one of the ten D6300 organisms gets a ceiling equal to its higher abundance in the two. That ceiling is subtracted from the species in every remaining sample where it is present (floored at zero), the removal is carried up the lineage and into the strain bins, and each sample is renormalised so its top-level rows sum to 100 again. `BC-0247292781` and `BC-0302370816` did not match the mix, so those rows were removed from the metadata and from the transformed table. The script is run here so the table on disk always matches the raw table and the metadata. The noise list is shown under Supplementary Figure 1.

Phylum, genus, and species are counted separately from that transformed table. The rank is the last token of `clade_name` (`p__`, `g__`, or `s__`). A `t__` row is a genome bin under a species and is not added to the species count. A taxon is detected when its reported abundance is above zero. The table below is that count, before any focal-group filter.

```{r load-size-data}
metadata <- read_csv(METADATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name_clean = clean_sample_id(sample_name),
    monument_name = plot_label(str_squish(str_replace_all(as.character(monument), "_", " ")))
  )

QC_POSITIVE_CONTROLS <- c(
  "BC-0247288828",
  "BC-0302366907"
)
MISLABELED_SAMPLES <- c(
  "BC-0247292781",
  "BC-0302370816"
)

ZYMO_D6300_SPECIES <- c(
  "Pseudomonas_aeruginosa",
  "Escherichia_coli",
  "Salmonella_enterica",
  "Limosilactobacillus_fermentum",  # Zymo sheet: Lactobacillus fermentum
  "Enterococcus_faecalis",
  "Staphylococcus_aureus",
  "Listeria_monocytogenes",
  "Bacillus_spizizenii",            # Zymo sheet: Bacillus subtilis
  "Saccharomyces_cerevisiae",
  "Cryptococcus_neoformans"
)

decontaminate_metaphlan <- function(root = ".",
                                    metaphlan_file = file.path(root, "input", "metaphlan_merged_all_taxa.tsv"),
                                    metadata_file = file.path(root, "input", "Monumentome_metadata.csv"),
                                    noise_out = file.path(root, "input", "positive_control_noise_species.tsv"),
                                    table_out = file.path(root, "input", "metaphlan_merged_all_taxa_decontaminated.tsv"),
                                    positive_control_type = "positive_control",
                                    positive_control_ids = QC_POSITIVE_CONTROLS,
                                    zymo_species = ZYMO_D6300_SPECIES,
                                    quiet = FALSE) {
  strip_s_suffix <- function(x) str_remove(as.character(x), "_S[0-9]+.*$")

  header_lines <- readLines(metaphlan_file, n = 5)
  header_lines <- header_lines[str_starts(header_lines, "#")]

  mp <- read_tsv(metaphlan_file, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal")
  if ("#clade_name" %in% names(mp)) names(mp)[names(mp) == "#clade_name"] <- "clade_name"
  sample_cols <- setdiff(names(mp), c("clade_name", "NCBI_tax_id"))
  sample_ids <- strip_s_suffix(sample_cols)
  # Mislabeled positive controls are not part of the analysis table.
  drop_cols <- sample_cols[sample_ids %in% MISLABELED_SAMPLES]
  if (length(drop_cols) != length(MISLABELED_SAMPLES)) {
    stop("Mislabeled samples missing from the MetaPhlAn table: ",
         paste(setdiff(MISLABELED_SAMPLES, sample_ids), collapse = ", "))
  }
  sample_cols <- setdiff(sample_cols, drop_cols)
  sample_ids <- strip_s_suffix(sample_cols)

  metadata <- read_csv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique")
  metadata_ids <- unique(strip_s_suffix(metadata$sample_name))
  # Sample columns that are not in the metadata are not paper samples.
  sample_cols <- sample_cols[sample_ids %in% metadata_ids]
  sample_ids <- strip_s_suffix(sample_cols)
  typed_positive <- metadata %>%
    filter(sample_type == positive_control_type) %>%
    pull(sample_name) %>%
    strip_s_suffix()
  positive_ids <- strip_s_suffix(positive_control_ids)
  missing_ids <- setdiff(positive_ids, typed_positive)
  if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
    stop("These QC positive controls are not typed ", positive_control_type, " in the metadata: ",
         paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "))
  }
  positive_cols <- sample_cols[sample_ids %in% positive_ids]
  if (length(positive_cols) != length(positive_ids)) {
    stop("These QC positive controls have no MetaPhlAn column: ",
         paste(setdiff(positive_ids, sample_ids), collapse = ", "))
  }

  mat <- as.matrix(mp[, sample_cols])
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  rownames(mat) <- mp$clade_name

  is_species_row <- str_detect(mp$clade_name, "\\|s__[^|]+$")
  species_name <- if_else(is_species_row, str_remove(str_extract(mp$clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^s__"), NA_character_)

  # Noise list: species seen in a positive control that are not in the standard.
  pos_mat <- mat[is_species_row, positive_cols, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(pos_mat) <- species_name[is_species_row]
  seen <- rowSums(pos_mat > 0) > 0
  noise <- tibble(
    species = rownames(pos_mat)[seen],
    ceiling_abundance = apply(pos_mat[seen, , drop = FALSE], 1, max),
    n_positive_controls = rowSums(pos_mat[seen, , drop = FALSE] > 0),
    positive_controls = apply(pos_mat[seen, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(v) paste(strip_s_suffix(positive_cols)[v > 0], collapse = ";"))
  ) %>%
    filter(!species %in% zymo_species) %>%
    arrange(desc(ceiling_abundance))

  # Subtract each noise species, propagate, then renormalise.
  removed_total <- setNames(numeric(length(sample_cols)), sample_cols)
  samples_touched <- setNames(integer(nrow(noise)), noise$species)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(noise))) {
    sp <- noise$species[i]
    row_i <- which(is_species_row & species_name == sp)
    if (length(row_i) != 1) stop("Species row not unique: ", sp)
    lineage <- mp$clade_name[row_i]
    ancestors <- which(vapply(mp$clade_name, function(cn) cn != lineage & str_starts(lineage, fixed(paste0(cn, "|"))), logical(1)))
    children <- which(str_starts(mp$clade_name, fixed(paste0(lineage, "|"))))

    ab <- mat[row_i, ]
    removed <- pmin(ab, noise$ceiling_abundance[i])
    samples_touched[sp] <- sum(removed > 0)
    removed_total <- removed_total + removed

    mat[row_i, ] <- ab - removed
    for (a in ancestors) mat[a, ] <- mat[a, ] - removed
    if (length(children)) {
      scale <- ifelse(ab > 0, (ab - removed) / ab, 1)
      mat[children, ] <- sweep(mat[children, , drop = FALSE], 2, scale, "*")
    }
  }
  mat[mat < 1e-9] <- 0

  top_rows <- !str_detect(mp$clade_name, fixed("|"))
  totals <- colSums(mat[top_rows, , drop = FALSE])
  factor <- ifelse(totals > 0, 100 / totals, 1)
  mat <- sweep(mat, 2, factor, "*")
  mat <- round(mat, 6)

  out <- bind_cols(tibble(clade_name = mp$clade_name), as_tibble(mat))
  if ("NCBI_tax_id" %in% names(mp)) out <- bind_cols(out[, 1], mp["NCBI_tax_id"], out[, -1])

  dir.create(dirname(table_out), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  writeLines(
    c(header_lines,
      paste0("#decontaminated ", format(Sys.Date()), ": ", nrow(noise),
             " positive-control noise species subtracted at their ceiling, then renormalised to 100 per sample (decontaminate_metaphlan.R)")),
    table_out
  )
  write_tsv(out, table_out, append = TRUE, col_names = TRUE)

  noise <- noise %>% mutate(n_samples_affected = unname(samples_touched[species]))
  write_tsv(noise, noise_out)

  summary <- tibble(
    sample = sample_ids,
    removed_before_renormalisation = unname(removed_total),
    renormalisation_factor = unname(factor)
  )

  if (!quiet) {
    message(sprintf("Positive controls: %s", paste(strip_s_suffix(positive_cols), collapse = ", ")))
    message(sprintf("Noise species: %d. Largest ceiling: %s (%.5f%%).", nrow(noise), noise$species[1], noise$ceiling_abundance[1]))
    message(sprintf("Samples with any subtraction: %d of %d. Largest total removed from one sample: %.4f%%.",
                    sum(removed_total > 0), length(sample_cols), max(removed_total)))
    message("Wrote ", table_out)
    message("Wrote ", noise_out)
  }

  invisible(list(noise = noise, sample_summary = summary, table_file = table_out, noise_file = noise_out))
}
still_present <- metadata$sample_name_clean %in% MISLABELED_SAMPLES
if (any(still_present) && !all(metadata$sample_type[still_present] == "mislabeled")) {
  stop("Mislabeled positive controls are still in the metadata without the mislabeled label.")
}
metadata <- metadata %>% filter(!still_present)
decontamination <- decontaminate_metaphlan(ROOT, quiet = TRUE)

read_metaphlan <- function(path) {
  wide <- read_tsv(path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal")
  if ("#clade_name" %in% names(wide)) {
    names(wide)[names(wide) == "#clade_name"] <- "clade_name"
  }
  cols <- setdiff(names(wide), c("clade_name", "NCBI_tax_id"))
  names(wide)[match(cols, names(wide))] <- clean_sample_id(cols)
  wide %>% mutate(rank_prefix = terminal_rank(clade_name))
}

metaphlan_wide <- read_metaphlan(METAPHLAN_FILE)
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(metaphlan_wide), c("clade_name", "NCBI_tax_id", "rank_prefix"))
metaphlan_raw_wide <- read_metaphlan(METAPHLAN_RAW_FILE) %>%
  select(any_of(c("clade_name", "NCBI_tax_id", "rank_prefix", sample_cols)))
stopifnot(identical(sample_cols, setdiff(names(metaphlan_raw_wide), c("clade_name", "NCBI_tax_id", "rank_prefix"))))
if (any(sample_cols %in% MISLABELED_SAMPLES)) {
  stop("Mislabeled samples are still in the transformed MetaPhlAn table.")
}

detected_at_rank <- function(prefix) {
  rank_rows <- metaphlan_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == prefix)
  detected <- colSums(as.matrix(rank_rows[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    rank = c("p__" = "phylum", "g__" = "genus", "s__" = "species")[prefix],
    clades_in_table = nrow(rank_rows),
    min_detected = min(detected),
    median_detected = median(detected),
    max_detected = max(detected)
  )
}

rank_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(c("p__", "g__", "s__"), detected_at_rank))
knitr::kable(
  rank_counts,
  caption = "MetaPhlAn detections after positive-control noise subtraction. Each rank is counted only from rows that end at that rank."
)

species_counts <- tibble(
  sample_name_clean = sample_cols,
  n_species = colSums(
    as.matrix(metaphlan_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == "s__") %>% select(all_of(sample_cols))) > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

size_samples <- metadata %>%
  filter(!sample_type %in% SEQUENCING_CONTROL_TYPES) %>%
  mutate(
    original_bases_gb = as.numeric(original_total_bases) / 1e9,
    clean_bases_gb = as.numeric(host_removed_total_bases) / 1e9
  ) %>%
  left_join(species_counts, by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    n_species = replace_na(n_species, 0L),
    microbiome_status = if_else(n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES, "Retained", "Dropped"),
    microbiome_status = factor(microbiome_status, levels = c("Dropped", "Retained"))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(monument_name),
    monument_name != "",
    monument_name != "NA",
    is.finite(original_bases_gb),
    original_bases_gb > 0
  )
```

# Supplementary Figure 1. Species composition of the control samples

The metadata has 2 positive microbial standards and 11 negative controls (air and unused surface swabs). This figure shows every one of them as a stacked bar of MetaPhlAn species abundance, as reported in the raw table, before the noise subtraction described above. It is the only figure drawn from the raw table. One bar is one control. Bars are grouped by control type. The number above a bar is the number of detected species. A control with no detected species is drawn as an empty slot so it is still counted.

`BC-0247292781` (Soldier's National Monument) and `BC-0302370816` (Seoul Tower) had been typed as positive standards. Their profiles did not match the ZymoBIOMICS mix, so they were removed from the metadata and are not drawn.

Three Tel Megiddo samples are typed `control` in the metadata, but their `material_details` say "Rock/Poll that everyone touch". They are swabs of a touched rock surface, not sequencing controls, so they are not drawn here.

The species colors cover the 15 species with the highest abundance in any single control, plus every species in the reference mix. Everything else is pooled as Other. Colors identify species, not materials or groups. Negative controls are labeled with the monument they were taken alongside. Positive standards are labeled with the sample ID only.

The leftmost bar is not a sample. It is the theoretical composition of the ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard (D6300, genomic DNA basis): eight bacteria at 12% each and two yeasts at 2% each. It sits beside the positive standards for comparison. Two names on the Zymo sheet differ from the names MetaPhlAn 4 reports: *Lactobacillus fermentum* is now *Limosilactobacillus fermentum* and the *Bacillus subtilis* strain is *Bacillus spizizenii*. The reference bar uses the MetaPhlAn names so each species has one color.

```{r figure-sup1, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, out.width="100%"}
FIGS1_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS1")
CONTROL_TYPE_LABELS <- c(
  positive_control = "Positive\nstandard",
  negative_control = "Negative control"
)
ZYMO_REFERENCE_LABEL <- "Zymo\nexpected"

# Theoretical composition of the ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard (D6300, genomic DNA basis).
# Names follow MetaPhlAn 4 so the colors match the sequenced standards:
# Zymo's Lactobacillus fermentum is Limosilactobacillus fermentum, and its Bacillus subtilis is Bacillus spizizenii.
zymo_reference <- tibble::tribble(
  ~taxon,                          ~abundance,
  "Pseudomonas_aeruginosa",        12,
  "Escherichia_coli",              12,
  "Salmonella_enterica",           12,
  "Limosilactobacillus_fermentum", 12,
  "Enterococcus_faecalis",         12,
  "Staphylococcus_aureus",         12,
  "Listeria_monocytogenes",        12,
  "Bacillus_spizizenii",           12,
  "Saccharomyces_cerevisiae",       2,
  "Cryptococcus_neoformans",        2
) %>%
  mutate(sample_name_clean = "ZYMO_REFERENCE", bar_label = "ZymoBIOMICS\nexpected composition")

# Controls are shown as sequenced, so species and counts come from the raw table.
raw_species_counts <- tibble(
  sample_name_clean = sample_cols,
  n_species = colSums(
    as.matrix(metaphlan_raw_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == "s__") %>% select(all_of(sample_cols))) > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

control_key <- metadata %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% names(CONTROL_TYPE_LABELS), sample_name_clean %in% sample_cols) %>%
  left_join(raw_species_counts, by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    n_species = replace_na(n_species, 0L),
    control_type = factor(CONTROL_TYPE_LABELS[sample_type], levels = c(ZYMO_REFERENCE_LABEL, CONTROL_TYPE_LABELS)),
    control_detail = coalesce(str_squish(as.character(control_info)), ""),
    # Positive standards are a reference mix, not a swab, so no location is printed.
    bar_label = case_when(
      sample_type == "positive_control" ~ sample_name_clean,
      control_detail == "" ~ paste0(monument_name, " (", sample_name_clean, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(monument_name, ", ", str_remove(control_detail, "^Negative "), " (", sample_name_clean, ")")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(control_type, desc(n_species), sample_name_clean) %>%
  mutate(bar_label = factor(bar_label, levels = unique(bar_label)))

control_species <- metaphlan_raw_wide %>%
  filter(rank_prefix == "s__") %>%
  mutate(taxon = str_remove(str_extract(clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^s__")) %>%
  select(taxon, all_of(control_key$sample_name_clean)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon, names_to = "sample_name_clean", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(abundance = as.numeric(abundance)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(abundance), abundance > 0)

control_top_species <- control_species %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(max_abundance = max(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(max_abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(taxon) %>%
  union(zymo_reference$taxon)

set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)
control_species_colors <- c(
  setNames(Polychrome::createPalette(length(control_top_species), seedcolors = pals::glasbey()), control_top_species),
  Other = "grey75"
)

control_bar_data <- control_species %>%
  mutate(taxon = if_else(taxon %in% control_top_species, taxon, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(sample_name_clean, taxon) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Controls with no detected species keep a zero-height bar so their slot is drawn.
  bind_rows(
    control_key %>%
      filter(!sample_name_clean %in% control_species$sample_name_clean) %>%
      transmute(sample_name_clean, taxon = "Other", abundance = 0)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(control_key %>% select(sample_name_clean, control_type, bar_label), by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  # The expected ZymoBIOMICS composition is drawn as its own reference bar beside the positive standards.
  bind_rows(zymo_reference %>% mutate(control_type = ZYMO_REFERENCE_LABEL)) %>%
  mutate(
    control_type = factor(control_type, levels = c(ZYMO_REFERENCE_LABEL, CONTROL_TYPE_LABELS)),
    bar_label = factor(bar_label, levels = c(unique(zymo_reference$bar_label), levels(control_key$bar_label))),
    taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(control_top_species, "Other"))
  )

control_count_labels <- control_key %>%
  select(sample_name_clean, control_type, bar_label, n_species) %>%
  bind_rows(
    zymo_reference %>%
      distinct(sample_name_clean, bar_label) %>%
      mutate(control_type = ZYMO_REFERENCE_LABEL, n_species = nrow(zymo_reference))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    control_type = factor(control_type, levels = levels(control_bar_data$control_type)),
    bar_label = factor(bar_label, levels = levels(control_bar_data$bar_label))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    control_bar_data %>% group_by(sample_name_clean) %>% summarise(total = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "sample_name_clean"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total = replace_na(total, 0))

p_s1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = control_bar_data,
    aes(bar_label, abundance, fill = taxon),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = control_count_labels,
    aes(bar_label, total + 3, label = n_species),
    size = pt_to_mm(by_mode(13, 6))
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(control_type), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = control_species_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "Species",
    labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, 108), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(
    title = "Species composition of every control sample",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance (%)"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  paper_theme_continuous() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = by_mode(12, 6), lineheight = 0.9, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = by_mode(14, 5.5), lineheight = 0.9),
    strip.clip = "off",
    legend.text = element_text(size = by_mode(12, 5.5), face = "italic"),
    legend.key.size = unit(by_mode(0.5, 0.26), "cm"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(by_mode(0.8, 0.5), "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(by_mode(8, 4), by_mode(14, 6), by_mode(8, 4), by_mode(8, 4))
  )

figs1_file <- save_panel(p_s1, FIGS1_DIR, "FigureS1_controls", width = 17, height = 11.5)
if (is_print()) figs1_file <- save_page(p_s1, OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS1_controls", height = 5.2)
knitr::include_graphics(figs1_file)
```

## Positive-control noise list and the transformed table

Every species in `BC-0247288828` or `BC-0302366907` that is not one of the ten D6300 organisms is listed below with its ceiling, the higher abundance it reached in those two standards. The transformed table is `input/metaphlan_merged_all_taxa_decontaminated.tsv`; the list is `input/positive_control_noise_species.tsv`. `n_samples_affected` counts every remaining sample, controls included, in which the species was present and therefore reduced.

```{r noise-list}
noise_species <- read_tsv(NOISE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
  noise_species %>%
    mutate(species = str_replace_all(species, "_", " "),
           positive_controls = str_replace_all(positive_controls, ";", ", ")),
  digits = 5,
  caption = "Species in the positive standards that are not part of the ZymoBIOMICS D6300 standard, with the ceiling subtracted from every sample."
)

decontamination_effect <- tibble(
  sample_name_clean = sample_cols,
  raw_species = colSums(as.matrix(metaphlan_raw_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == "s__") %>% select(all_of(sample_cols))) > 0),
  transformed_species = colSums(as.matrix(metaphlan_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == "s__") %>% select(all_of(sample_cols))) > 0)
)
n_retention_changed <- sum((decontamination_effect$raw_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES) !=
                             (decontamination_effect$transformed_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES))
decontamination_effect <- decontamination_effect %>%
  filter(raw_species != transformed_species) %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(sample_name_clean, sample_type, monument_name), by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  arrange(sample_type, desc(raw_species - transformed_species))

knitr::kable(
  decontamination_effect,
  caption = paste0(
    "Samples whose detected species count changed after the subtraction. Samples whose retention status (at least ",
    MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES, " species) changed: ", n_retention_changed, "."
  )
)
```

# Supplementary Figure 2. Sequenced bases, species, and clean bases

Both panels use sequenced bases from the metadata, not the compressed FASTQ file size. Original bases are `original_total_bases`. Clean bases are `host_removed_total_bases`, the bases left after adapter trimming and human-read removal. Both are drawn in gigabases. Positive and negative sequencing controls are not monument samples and are left out of both panels. A sample with no original base count is not drawn. A sample with no host-removed base count stays in panel A and is left out of the paired comparison in panel B.

The analysis notebook drew this scatter from trimmed sequencing depth and added a linear regression line. Panel A keeps dropped samples red and drops the line. The x value is the original R1+R2 sequenced bases. The y value is the species count from the transformed table above: rows that end at `s__`, not genus rows and not `t__` bins. Spearman correlation is `stats::cor.test` (`exact = FALSE` because of ties). A sample is retained at 2 or more of those species.

Panel B gives each monument on the original `monument` list two boxes: original R1+R2 bases, and bases left after adapter trimming and human removal. Clean bases are lower than original bases for every sample. Collapsed site codes and the five focal groups are not used. Monuments with at least 6 paired samples are tested with `rstatix::wilcox_test(paired = TRUE)` on log10 bases, then Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across those monuments. A `*` marks adjusted p < 0.05. Monuments with fewer than 6 pairs are listed and not tested.

Original bases are dark grey. Clean bases are sky blue (`#56B4E9`). Those fills are library stage, not material.

```{r figure-sup2, fig.width=12, fig.height=16.5, out.width="100%"}
FIGS2_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS2")
depth_species <- size_samples %>%
  mutate(log10_original_bases = log10(original_bases_gb))

spearman_size <- cor.test(
  depth_species$log10_original_bases,
  depth_species$n_species,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

p_s2a <- ggplot(depth_species, aes(log10_original_bases, n_species, color = microbiome_status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = gs(3)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(Dropped = DROPPED_SAMPLE_COLOR, Retained = RETAINED_SAMPLE_COLOR),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Sample status"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = gs(4), alpha = 1))) +
  labs(
    tag = "A",
    title = "Original sequenced bases and detected species",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Spearman rho = %.3f, p = %.3g",
      unname(spearman_size$estimate),
      spearman_size$p.value
    ),
    x = "log10 original R1+R2 sequenced bases (Gb)",
    y = "Detected species"
  ) +
  paper_theme_continuous() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

monument_levels <- depth_species %>%
  count(monument_name, name = "n_samples") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples), monument_name) %>%
  pull(monument_name)

paired_sizes <- depth_species %>%
  filter(is.finite(original_bases_gb), is.finite(clean_bases_gb), original_bases_gb > 0, clean_bases_gb > 0)

if (any(paired_sizes$clean_bases_gb > paired_sizes$original_bases_gb)) {
  stop("Clean bases exceed original bases for at least one sample.")
}

paired_sizes <- paired_sizes %>%
  mutate(
    log10_original = log10(original_bases_gb),
    log10_clean = log10(clean_bases_gb)
  )

pair_counts <- paired_sizes %>%
  count(monument_name, name = "n_pairs")

size_long <- paired_sizes %>%
  select(sample_name_clean, monument_name, log10_original, log10_clean) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(log10_original, log10_clean),
    names_to = "library",
    values_to = "log10_gb"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    library = recode(
      library,
      log10_original = "Original bases",
      log10_clean = "Clean bases"
    ),
    library = factor(library, levels = names(LIBRARY_COLORS))
  ) %>%
  arrange(monument_name, library, sample_name_clean)

size_tests <- size_long %>%
  group_by(monument_name) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(sample_name_clean) >= 6) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    log10_gb ~ library,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE,
    p.adjust.method = "none"
  ) %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(pair_counts, by = "monument_name") %>%
  transmute(
    monument = monument_name,
    n_pairs,
    statistic,
    p,
    p_adj = p.adj,
    significance = p.adj.signif
  )

if (!is_print()) knitr::kable(
  size_tests,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test of log10 original bases versus log10 clean bases. P-values are Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted across tested monuments."
)

not_tested <- pair_counts %>%
  filter(n_pairs < 6) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pairs), monument_name)
if (nrow(not_tested) > 0 && !is_print()) {
  knitr::kable(
    not_tested,
    caption = "Monuments not tested: fewer than 6 samples with both original bases and clean bases."
  )
}

sig_monuments <- size_tests %>%
  filter(is.finite(p_adj), p_adj < 0.05) %>%

monument_labels <- setNames(monument_levels, monument_levels)
monument_labels[sig_monuments] <- paste0(monument_labels[sig_monuments], " *")
```

# Supplementary Figure 3. Species UMAP colored by place, season, material, and climate

This is the same kind of species UMAP as the analysis notebook's confounding figure, redrawn for the supplement. Samples are those with at least 2 detected species. The embedding is Hellinger-transformed species abundance, then UMAP with the same seed and settings as Figure 2A in the main text. One embedding is colored six ways. An ellipse is drawn only for a group with at least 3 samples.

Material uses the paper colors: rock/stone green, granite pink, metal brown, marble dark yellow, others blue. The other panels use Paul Tol's color-blind-safe set. Within each of those panels the largest group gets the first, darkest color. Monument names are printed with spaces instead of underscores. The default ggplot rainbow is not used, because several of those hues collapse for red-green color blindness.

```{r figure-sup3, fig.width=16, fig.height=11, out.width="100%"}
FIGS3_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS3")
assign_tol <- function(levels) {
  if (length(levels) > length(TOL_SAFE)) stop("Not enough color-blind-safe colors for this panel.")
  setNames(TOL_SAFE[seq_along(levels)], levels)
}

levels_by_size <- function(x) {
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))
}

retained_ids <- metadata %>%
  filter(!sample_type %in% SEQUENCING_CONTROL_TYPES) %>%
  inner_join(species_counts, by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  filter(n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES, sample_name_clean %in% sample_cols) %>%
  pull(sample_name_clean)

species_table <- metaphlan_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == "s__")
umap_species_names <- str_remove(str_extract(species_table$clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^s__")
if (anyDuplicated(umap_species_names)) umap_species_names <- make.unique(umap_species_names)

umap_species_matrix <- t(as.matrix(species_table[, retained_ids, drop = FALSE]))
colnames(umap_species_matrix) <- umap_species_names
umap_species_matrix <- umap_species_matrix[, colSums(umap_species_matrix) > 0, drop = FALSE]
storage.mode(umap_species_matrix) <- "numeric"

hellinger_matrix <- decostand(umap_species_matrix, method = "hellinger")
hellinger_matrix <- hellinger_matrix[, apply(hellinger_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)
s3_umap <- uwot::umap(
  hellinger_matrix,
  n_neighbors = min(15L, nrow(hellinger_matrix) - 1L),
  min_dist = 0.20,
  n_components = 2L,
  metric = "euclidean",
  scale = FALSE,
  init = "spectral",
  n_threads = 1L,
  verbose = FALSE
)
colnames(s3_umap) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
rownames(s3_umap) <- rownames(hellinger_matrix)

umap_data <- metadata %>%
  filter(sample_name_clean %in% rownames(umap_species_matrix)) %>%
  mutate(
    monument_name = plot_label(str_replace_all(as.character(monument_final), "_", " ")),
    season_name = plot_label(as.character(seasons_final)),
    material_name = plot_label(normalize_material(materials_final)),
    climate_name = plot_label(as.character(koppen_geiger_code)),
    country = plot_label(as.character(country)),
    city = plot_label(as.character(city))
  )
umap_data <- bind_cols(
  umap_data,
  as.data.frame(s3_umap[umap_data$sample_name_clean, , drop = FALSE])
)

country_colors <- assign_tol(levels_by_size(umap_data$country))
city_colors <- assign_tol(levels_by_size(umap_data$city))
monument_colors <- assign_tol(levels_by_size(umap_data$monument_name))
season_colors <- c(
  Summer = "#D55E00",
  Winter = "#0072B2",
  Autumn = "#009E73",
  Spring = "#CC79A7"
)
climate_colors <- assign_tol(levels_by_size(umap_data$climate_name))

plot_confounder_umap <- function(data, group_col, title, tag, colors, legend_title) {
  dat <- data %>%
    mutate(.group = as.character(.data[[group_col]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.group), .group != "", .group != "Unknown")
  ellipse_dat <- dat %>% add_count(.group, name = ".n") %>% filter(.n >= 3)
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = .group)) +
    geom_point(size = gs(3), alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = legend_title, drop = TRUE) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      ncol = if (n_distinct(dat$.group) > 12) 2 else 1,
      override.aes = list(size = gs(4), alpha = 1)
    )) +
    labs(tag = tag, title = title, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    paper_theme_continuous() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  if (nrow(ellipse_dat) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_ellipse(
      data = ellipse_dat,
      aes(group = .group),
      level = ELLIPSE_LEVEL,
      linewidth = gs(0.8),
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  p
}

p_s3a <- plot_confounder_umap(umap_data, "country", "Country", "A", country_colors, "Country")
p_s3b <- plot_confounder_umap(umap_data, "city", "City", "B", city_colors, "City")
p_s3c <- plot_confounder_umap(umap_data, "monument_name", "Monument", "C", monument_colors, "Monument")
p_s3d <- plot_confounder_umap(umap_data, "season_name", "Season", "D", season_colors, "Season")
p_s3e <- plot_confounder_umap(umap_data, "material_name", "Material", "E", MATERIAL_COLORS, "Material")
p_s3f <- plot_confounder_umap(umap_data, "climate_name", "Koppen-Geiger climate", "F", climate_colors, "Climate")

layer_range <- function(p) {
  pieces <- ggplot_build(p)$data
  xs <- unlist(lapply(pieces, function(d) if ("x" %in% names(d)) d$x else numeric()))
  ys <- unlist(lapply(pieces, function(d) if ("y" %in% names(d)) d$y else numeric()))
  c(range(xs, na.rm = TRUE), range(ys, na.rm = TRUE))
}
panel_ranges <- lapply(list(p_s3a, p_s3b, p_s3c, p_s3d, p_s3e, p_s3f), layer_range)
umap_xlim <- range(vapply(panel_ranges, function(r) r[1:2], numeric(2)))
umap_ylim <- range(vapply(panel_ranges, function(r) r[3:4], numeric(2)))
umap_xlim <- umap_xlim + c(-1, 1) * diff(umap_xlim) * 0.04
umap_ylim <- umap_ylim + c(-1, 1) * diff(umap_ylim) * 0.04
share_limits <- function(p) {
  p + coord_cartesian(xlim = umap_xlim, ylim = umap_ylim, expand = FALSE)
}
p_s3a <- share_limits(p_s3a)
p_s3b <- share_limits(p_s3b)
p_s3c <- share_limits(p_s3c)
p_s3d <- share_limits(p_s3d)
p_s3e <- share_limits(p_s3e)
p_s3f <- share_limits(p_s3f)

figs3_files <- c(
  save_panel(p_s3a, FIGS3_DIR, "FigureS3A_umap_country", width = 10.5, height = 8),
  save_panel(p_s3b, FIGS3_DIR, "FigureS3B_umap_city", width = 11.5, height = 8),
  save_panel(p_s3c, FIGS3_DIR, "FigureS3C_umap_monument", width = 13.5, height = 8),
  save_panel(p_s3d, FIGS3_DIR, "FigureS3D_umap_season", width = 10.5, height = 8),
  save_panel(p_s3e, FIGS3_DIR, "FigureS3E_umap_material", width = 10.5, height = 8),
  save_panel(p_s3f, FIGS3_DIR, "FigureS3F_umap_climate", width = 10.5, height = 8)
)
if (is_print()) {
  figure_s3 <- (
    (blk(p_s3a) | blk(p_s3b)) /
    (blk(p_s3c) | blk(p_s3d)) /
    (blk(p_s3e) | blk(p_s3f))
  ) + plot_layout(heights = c(3.3, 3.3, 3.3))
  figs3_files <- save_page(figure_s3, OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS3_umap_confounders", height = 9.9)
}
knitr::include_graphics(figs3_files)
```
