The combined figure is `paper_output/FigureS3_umap_confounders.pdf` and `paper_output/FigureS3_umap_confounders.png`. Saved panels are in `paper_output/FigureS3/`: `FigureS3A_umap_country.png`, `FigureS3B_umap_city.png`, `FigureS3C_umap_monument.png`, `FigureS3D_umap_season.png`, `FigureS3E_umap_material.png`, and `FigureS3F_umap_climate.png`.

# Supplementary Figure 4. Genus and phylum versions of Figure 2

Figure 2 in the main text is the species comparison of the five focal groups. This figure repeats four of those panels at genus and at phylum: accumulated richness, Shannon diversity, Jaccard NMDS, and the median Jaccard heatmap. Genus is the left column. Phylum is the right column.

The samples are the same five focal groups, kept when a sample has at least 2 detected species. Genus and phylum values are the MetaPhlAn rows that end at `g__` and `p__`. They are not renormalized. Accumulation and Jaccard distances use presence. Shannon uses the reported abundances. The group colors are the material colors from the main figures. Axis names are stacked, and legend names use a plain hyphen.

Shannon uses a Kruskal-Wallis test. The NMDS uses Jaccard distances, PERMANOVA with 999 permutations, and the same seed as Figure 2. Taxa detected in only one sample are omitted, as in Figure 2, so that the NMDS does not collapse. The heatmap shows one triangle: the diagonal is the median distance inside a group, and the other filled cells are the median distance between two groups.

```{r figure-sup4, fig.width=14, fig.height=22, out.width="100%"}
FIGS4_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS4")
# Check panels carry their own legend. In the print page one shared legend sits under them.
focal_legend_bottom <- if (is_print()) {
  list(theme(legend.position = "none"))
} else {
  list(
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top", override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))),
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  )
}

# One-row legend of the five focal groups for the print page.
focal_group_legend <- function() {
  src <- ggplot(
    tibble(focal_group = factor(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS), x = 1, y = 1),
    aes(x, y, color = focal_group)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, labels = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS, name = "Focal group") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2.4))) +
    theme_void(base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  patchwork::wrap_elements(full = cowplot::get_legend(src))
}

focal_sample_key <- metadata %>%
  # Positive standards were logged against Orpheus and Soldier's National Monument
  # with material marble; without this filter they would land in United States — marble.
  filter(!sample_type %in% SEQUENCING_CONTROL_TYPES) %>%
  inner_join(species_counts, by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    n_species = replace_na(n_species, 0L),
    materials_plot = normalize_material(materials_final),
    focal_group = case_when(
      n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES &
        country == "Brazil" & monument_final == "Parque_Ibirapuera" & materials_plot == "granite" ~ FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[1],
      n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES &
        country == "Israel" & monument_final == "Tel_Megiddo" & materials_plot == "others" ~ FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[2],
      n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES &
        country == "Israel" & monument_final == "Tel_Megiddo" & materials_plot == "rock/stone" ~ FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[3],
      n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES &
        country == "United States" & monument %in% c("Orpheus", "Soldier's National Monument") & materials_plot == "marble" ~ FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[4],
      n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES &
        country == "United States" & monument %in% c("Charging Bull", "Fearless Girl") & materials_plot == "metal" ~ FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[5],
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(focal_group), sample_name_clean %in% sample_cols) %>%
  distinct(sample_name_clean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(focal_group = factor(focal_group, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS))
stopifnot(nrow(focal_sample_key) > 0, min(focal_sample_key$n_species) >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES)

rank_matrix <- function(prefix, sample_ids) {
  rank_rows <- metaphlan_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == prefix)
  taxa <- str_remove(str_extract(rank_rows$clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^[kpcofgst]__")
  if (anyDuplicated(taxa)) taxa <- make.unique(taxa)
  mat <- t(as.matrix(rank_rows[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]))
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  colnames(mat) <- taxa
  mat[, colSums(mat) > 0, drop = FALSE]
}

focal_rank_panels <- function(prefix, rank_label, tags) {
  sample_ids <- focal_sample_key$sample_name_clean
  rank_mat <- rank_matrix(prefix, sample_ids)
  rank_meta <- focal_sample_key %>%
    filter(sample_name_clean %in% rownames(rank_mat)) %>%
    arrange(match(sample_name_clean, rownames(rank_mat)))
  rank_mat <- rank_mat[rank_meta$sample_name_clean, , drop = FALSE]
  presence <- 1L * (rank_mat > 0)

  set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)
  accumulation_data <- bind_rows(lapply(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS, function(group_name) {
    ids <- rank_meta %>% filter(focal_group == group_name) %>% pull(sample_name_clean)
    acc <- specaccum(presence[ids, , drop = FALSE], method = "random", permutations = RICHNESS_PERMUTATIONS)
    tibble(
      focal_group = group_name,
      n_samples = acc$sites,
      accumulated_richness = acc$richness,
      richness_sd = acc$sd
    )
  })) %>%
    mutate(focal_group = factor(focal_group, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS))

  p_accum <- ggplot(accumulation_data, aes(n_samples, accumulated_richness, color = focal_group, fill = focal_group)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = pmax(0, accumulated_richness - richness_sd), ymax = accumulated_richness + richness_sd),
      alpha = 0.18,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = gs(1.2)) +
    geom_point(size = gs(2)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, labels = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS, drop = FALSE, name = "Focal group") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, labels = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS, drop = FALSE, name = "Focal group", guide = "none") +
    labs(
      tag = tags[1],
      title = paste(rank_label, "accumulation"),
      x = "Number of samples",
      y = paste("Accumulated", tolower(rank_label), "richness")
    ) +
    paper_theme_continuous() +
    focal_legend_bottom

  alpha_data <- rank_meta %>%
    mutate(shannon = diversity(rank_mat, index = "shannon"))
  shannon_kw <- kruskal.test(shannon ~ focal_group, data = alpha_data)

  p_shannon <- ggplot(alpha_data, aes(focal_group, shannon, color = focal_group, fill = focal_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = gs(2.2), alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels()) +
    labs(
      tag = tags[2],
      title = paste(rank_label, "Shannon diversity"),
      subtitle = sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g", shannon_kw$p.value),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Shannon diversity"
    ) +
    paper_theme_upright() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  rank_beta <- jaccard_beta(
    rank_mat,
    rank_meta$focal_group,
    nperm = N_PERMUTATIONS,
    seed = RANDOM_SEED
  )
  permanova <- rank_beta$permanova
  nmds_data <- rank_meta %>%
    inner_join(tibble::rownames_to_column(rank_beta$scores, "sample_name_clean"), by = "sample_name_clean")

  p_pcoa <- ggplot(nmds_data, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = focal_group)) +
    geom_point(size = gs(3), alpha = 0.85) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = focal_group), level = ELLIPSE_LEVEL, linewidth = gs(0.8), show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, labels = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS, drop = FALSE, name = "Focal group") +
    labs(
      tag = tags[3],
      title = paste(rank_label, "Jaccard NMDS"),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "n = %d; stress = %.3f\nPERMANOVA R2 = %.3f, %s",
        rank_beta$n_samples, rank_beta$stress, permanova$R2[1], perm_p_text(permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1])
      ),
      x = "NMDS1",
      y = "NMDS2"
    ) +
    paper_theme_continuous() +
    focal_legend_bottom
  ellipse_pieces <- ggplot_build(p_pcoa)$data
  ellipse_x <- unlist(lapply(ellipse_pieces, function(d) if ("x" %in% names(d)) d$x else numeric()))
  ellipse_y <- unlist(lapply(ellipse_pieces, function(d) if ("y" %in% names(d)) d$y else numeric()))
  ellipse_xlim <- range(ellipse_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  ellipse_ylim <- range(ellipse_y, na.rm = TRUE)
  ellipse_xlim <- ellipse_xlim + c(-1, 1) * diff(ellipse_xlim) * 0.04
  ellipse_ylim <- ellipse_ylim + c(-1, 1) * diff(ellipse_ylim) * 0.04
  p_pcoa <- p_pcoa + coord_cartesian(xlim = ellipse_xlim, ylim = ellipse_ylim, expand = FALSE)

  bray_matrix <- as.matrix(rank_beta$dist)
  pair_index <- which(upper.tri(bray_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
  group_lookup <- setNames(as.integer(rank_meta$focal_group), rank_meta$sample_name_clean)
  group_1 <- group_lookup[rownames(bray_matrix)[pair_index[, 1]]]
  group_2 <- group_lookup[colnames(bray_matrix)[pair_index[, 2]]]
  median_bray <- tibble(
    group_low = pmin(group_1, group_2),
    group_high = pmax(group_1, group_2),
    bray_curtis = bray_matrix[pair_index]
  ) %>%
    group_by(group_low, group_high) %>%
    summarise(median_distance = median(bray_curtis), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      x = factor(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[group_low], levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS),
      y = factor(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS[group_high], levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS),
      label = sprintf("%.2f", median_distance)
    )

  p_median <- ggplot(median_bray, aes(x, y, fill = median_distance)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = gs(0.6)) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label, color = ifelse(median_distance > 0.85, "white", "grey10")),
      size = pt_to_mm(by_mode(14, 6)),
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels(), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels(), limits = rev(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS), drop = FALSE) +
    colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_sequential(
      palette = "Blues 3",
      rev = TRUE,
      limits = c(0, 1),
      name = "Median distance"
    ) +
    labs(tag = tags[4], title = paste(rank_label, "median Jaccard"), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    paper_theme_continuous() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.95),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (is_print()) c(0.80, 0.80) else "right"
    ) +
    coord_fixed()

  list(accum = p_accum, shannon = p_shannon, pcoa = p_pcoa, median = p_median)
}

genus_panels <- focal_rank_panels("g__", "Genus", c("A", "C", "E", "G"))
phylum_panels <- focal_rank_panels("p__", "Phylum", c("B", "D", "F", "H"))

figs4_files <- c(
  save_panel(genus_panels$accum, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4A_genus_accumulation", width = 10, height = 8.5),
  save_panel(phylum_panels$accum, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4B_phylum_accumulation", width = 10, height = 8.5),
  save_panel(genus_panels$shannon, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4C_genus_shannon", width = 10, height = 7.5),
  save_panel(phylum_panels$shannon, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4D_phylum_shannon", width = 10, height = 7.5),
  save_panel(genus_panels$pcoa, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4E_genus_jaccard_nmds", width = 10, height = 8.5),
  save_panel(phylum_panels$pcoa, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4F_phylum_jaccard_nmds", width = 10, height = 8.5),
  save_panel(genus_panels$median, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4G_genus_median_jaccard", width = 11.5, height = 10),
  save_panel(phylum_panels$median, FIGS4_DIR, "FigureS4H_phylum_median_jaccard", width = 11.5, height = 10)
)
if (is_print()) {
  figs4_heights <- c(2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 3.1, 0.35)
  figure_s4 <- (
    (blk(genus_panels$accum) | blk(phylum_panels$accum)) /
    (blk(genus_panels$shannon) | blk(phylum_panels$shannon)) /
    (blk(genus_panels$pcoa) | blk(phylum_panels$pcoa)) /
    (blk(genus_panels$median) | blk(phylum_panels$median)) /
    focal_group_legend()
  ) + plot_layout(heights = figs4_heights)
  figs4_files <- save_page(figure_s4, OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS4_genus_phylum", height = sum(figs4_heights))
}
knitr::include_graphics(figs4_files)
```

The combined figure is `paper_output/FigureS4_genus_phylum.pdf` and `paper_output/FigureS4_genus_phylum.png`. Saved panels are in `paper_output/FigureS4/`: `FigureS4A_genus_accumulation.png`, `FigureS4B_phylum_accumulation.png`, `FigureS4C_genus_shannon.png`, `FigureS4D_phylum_shannon.png`, `FigureS4E_genus_jaccard_nmds.png`, `FigureS4F_phylum_jaccard_nmds.png`, `FigureS4G_genus_median_jaccard.png`, and `FigureS4H_phylum_median_jaccard.png`.

# Supplementary Figure 5. Shared detections and group cores

Figure 3 counts how many taxa fall in each overlap region. It does not say whether a named species is common inside a group. This figure does. Prevalence is the percent of retained samples in a focal group in which the species abundance is above zero. A core species is present in at least 75% of that group's samples.

The figure is one heatmap. The upper block is every species detected in all five focal groups. The lower block, labeled one-group core, is every species that reaches 75% in one group and is absent from at least one other group. Three species are both shared and core somewhere; they stay in the upper block, with an asterisk in the group where they are core. Fill is prevalence. An asterisk marks a cell at or above 75%. Species names are italic, with underscores printed as spaces. The group labels are the same stacked labels as Figure 3.

The abundance table under the figure is a different number. It is the mean relative abundance, from the transformed table, among the samples in which that species was detected. A blank means the species was absent, so there is no positive mean. No further renormalization is applied beyond the one in `decontaminate_metaphlan.R`.

```{r figure-sup5, fig.width=12, fig.height=18, out.width="100%"}
FIGS5_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS5")
species_rows <- metaphlan_wide %>% filter(rank_prefix == "s__")
focal_ids <- focal_sample_key$sample_name_clean
species_names <- str_remove(str_extract(species_rows$clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^s__")
if (anyDuplicated(species_names)) species_names <- make.unique(species_names)
species_matrix <- t(as.matrix(species_rows[, focal_ids, drop = FALSE]))
storage.mode(species_matrix) <- "numeric"
colnames(species_matrix) <- species_names
species_matrix <- species_matrix[, colSums(species_matrix) > 0, drop = FALSE]

species_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS, function(group_name) {
  ids <- focal_sample_key %>% filter(focal_group == group_name) %>% pull(sample_name_clean)
  group_matrix <- species_matrix[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  present <- group_matrix > 0
  tibble(
    focal_group = group_name,
    taxon = colnames(group_matrix),
    prevalence = 100 * colMeans(present),
    mean_positive_abundance = colMeans(group_matrix * present) / pmax(colMeans(present), .Machine$double.eps)
  ) %>%
    mutate(mean_positive_abundance = if_else(prevalence > 0, mean_positive_abundance, NA_real_))
})) %>%
  mutate(focal_group = factor(focal_group, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS))

species_flags <- species_summary %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    n_groups = sum(prevalence > 0),
    n_core = sum(prevalence >= CORE_THRESHOLD * 100),
    mean_prevalence = mean(prevalence),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shared_species <- species_flags %>%
  filter(n_groups == length(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_prevalence)) %>%
  pull(taxon)
core_only_species <- species_flags %>%
  filter(n_core >= 1, n_groups < length(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS)) %>%
  pull(taxon)

core_group_rank <- species_summary %>%
  filter(taxon %in% core_only_species, prevalence >= CORE_THRESHOLD * 100) %>%
  mutate(group_rank = as.integer(focal_group)) %>%
  arrange(group_rank, desc(prevalence))
core_only_species <- unique(core_group_rank$taxon)

species_block <- c(
  setNames(rep("Detected in all five groups", length(shared_species)), shared_species),
  setNames(rep("One-group core", length(core_only_species)), core_only_species)
)
heatmap_levels <- rev(c(shared_species, core_only_species))

prevalence_data <- species_summary %>%
  filter(taxon %in% names(species_block)) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = factor(taxon, levels = heatmap_levels),
    block = factor(species_block[as.character(taxon)], levels = unique(species_block)),
    species_label = str_replace_all(as.character(taxon), "_", " ")
  )

p_s5 <- ggplot(prevalence_data, aes(focal_group, taxon, fill = prevalence)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = gs(0.4)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(prevalence >= CORE_THRESHOLD * 100, "*", "")),
    color = "white",
    size = pt_to_mm(by_mode(20, 8)),
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(block), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", labeller = labeller(block = label_wrap_gen(by_mode(40, 12)))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels(), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")) +
  colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_sequential(
    palette = "Blues 3",
    rev = TRUE,
    limits = c(0, 100),
    name = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of shared and core species",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  paper_theme_continuous() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = by_mode(13, FIG_BASE_SIZE)),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = by_mode(13, FIG_BASE_SIZE)),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(by_mode(8, 4), by_mode(18, 8), by_mode(8, 4), by_mode(8, 4))
  )

abundance_table <- prevalence_data %>%
  mutate(
    species = str_replace_all(as.character(taxon), "_", " "),
    group_label = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS[as.character(focal_group)],
    block = as.character(block)
  ) %>%
  select(block, species, group_label, mean_positive_abundance) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_positive_abundance = case_when(
      is.na(mean_positive_abundance) ~ NA_character_,
      mean_positive_abundance > 0 & mean_positive_abundance < 0.01 ~ "<0.01",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", mean_positive_abundance)
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group_label, values_from = mean_positive_abundance) %>%
  arrange(match(species, str_replace_all(c(shared_species, core_only_species), "_", " "))) %>%
  select(block, species, all_of(unname(FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS[FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS])))

write_tsv(abundance_table, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS5_mean_positive_abundance.tsv"))

figs5_file <- save_panel(p_s5, FIGS5_DIR, "FigureS5_shared_core_species", width = 11.5, height = 3.5 + 0.34 * length(heatmap_levels))
if (is_print()) {
  figs5_file <- save_page(p_s5, OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS5_shared_core_species", height = 1.5 + 0.125 * length(heatmap_levels))
}
knitr::include_graphics(figs5_file)
```

```{r figure-sup5-table}
abundance_display <- abundance_table %>%
  mutate(across(-c(block, species), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), "absent", .x)))
knitr::kable(
  abundance_display,
  caption = "Mean MetaPhlAn relative abundance (%) among samples in which the species was detected. Absent means the species was not detected in that group. Values below 0.01% are shown as <0.01."
)
```

The heatmap is `paper_output/FigureS5_shared_core_species.pdf` and `paper_output/FigureS5_shared_core_species.png`. The panel is also in `paper_output/FigureS5/`. The table behind it is `paper_output/FigureS5_mean_positive_abundance.tsv`.

# Supplementary Figure 6. Taxonomy tree of the Microbe Directory species, with group prevalence and traits

The directory contains characterised species only. Of the 1,741 species detected in the five focal groups, 224 (12.9%) match a species record there. The other 1,517, including unnamed species-level genome bins, have no record and are not annotated. The matched Microbe Directory rows are written to `paper_output/FigureS6_microbe_directory_annotations.tsv`. A species with more than one directory row keeps every row. Volunteer names are omitted.

```{r figure-sup6, fig.width=14, fig.height=12, out.width="100%"}
FIGS6_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS6")
TMD_TRAITS <- tibble::tribble(
  ~trait_group, ~trait, ~source_col, ~pattern,
  "Extremophile", "Acidophile", "extremophile_type", "\\bAcidophile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Alkaliphile", "extremophile_type", "\\bAlkaliphile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Halophile", "extremophile_type", "\\bHalophile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Thermophile", "extremophile_type", "\\bThermophile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Psychrophile", "extremophile_type", "\\bPsychrophile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Xerophile", "extremophile_type", "\\bXerophile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Oligotroph", "extremophile_type", "\\bOligotroph\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Barophile", "extremophile_type", "\\bBarophile\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Metallotolerant", "extremophile_type", "\\bMetallotolerant\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Radioresistant", "extremophile_type", "\\bRadioresistant\\b",
  "Extremophile", "Hypolith", "extremophile_type", "\\bHypolith\\b",
  "Surface persistence", "Biofilm forming", "biofilm_forming", "^Yes$",
  "Surface persistence", "Spore forming", "spore_forming", "^Yes$",
  "Surface persistence", "UV resistant", "euk_uv_resistant", "^Yes$",
  "Surface persistence", "Antimicrobial activity", "antimicrobial_activity", "^Yes$",
  "Surface persistence", "Pigment producer", "euk_pigmentation", "^Yes$",
  "Metabolism", "Phototroph", "metabolism_energy", "\\b(Photo|Phototroph)\\b",
  "Metabolism", "Chemotroph", "metabolism_energy", "\\b(Chemo|Chemotroph)\\b",
  "Metabolism", "Lithotroph", "metabolism_electron_source", "\\bLitho\\b",
  "Metabolism", "Organotroph", "metabolism_electron_source", "\\b(Organo|Organotroph)\\b",
  "Metabolism", "Autotroph", "metabolism_carbon_source", "\\bAutotroph\\b",
  "Metabolism", "Heterotroph", "metabolism_carbon_source", "\\bHeterotroph\\b",
  "Metabolism", "Aerobic", "bac_oxygen_use", "(^|[ _])Aerobes($|[ _])|Obligate_aerobes",
  # "Facultative_anaerobes" and "Aerotolerant_anaerobes" end in "_anaerobes", so the word is
  # only matched after the start of the value or a space, never after an underscore.
  "Metabolism", "Anaerobic", "bac_oxygen_use", "(^|[ ])Anaerobes($|[ ])|Obligate_anaerobes",
  "Metabolism", "Facultative anaerobe", "bac_oxygen_use", "Facultative_anaerobes",
  "Metabolism", "Microaerophile", "bac_oxygen_use", "Microaerophile"
)

clean_tmd_species <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:]]+", "_") %>%
    str_remove("^_") %>%
    str_remove("_$") %>%
    str_to_lower()
}

tmd <- read_csv(TMD_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

focal_species_annotation <- tibble(
  metaphlan_species = colnames(species_matrix),
  species_match_key = clean_tmd_species(metaphlan_species)
)
md2_annotation <- tmd %>%
  filter(str_to_lower(rank) == "species") %>%
  mutate(species_match_key = clean_tmd_species(scientific_name)) %>%
  inner_join(focal_species_annotation, by = "species_match_key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  select(-any_of(c("volunteer_name", "species_match_key"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "[[:space:]]+", " "))) %>%
  relocate(metaphlan_species) %>%
  arrange(metaphlan_species, scientific_name, taxonomy_id)
n_focal_species <- nrow(focal_species_annotation)
n_md2_annotated <- n_distinct(md2_annotation$metaphlan_species)
stopifnot(n_focal_species == 1741L, n_md2_annotated == 224L)
write_tsv(md2_annotation, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS6_microbe_directory_annotations.tsv"))

tmd_species_traits <- tmd %>%
  filter(str_to_lower(rank) == "species") %>%
  mutate(species_match_key = clean_tmd_species(scientific_name)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(unique(TMD_TRAITS$source_col)), names_to = "source_col", values_to = "trait_value") %>%
  inner_join(TMD_TRAITS, by = "source_col", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(str_detect(coalesce(as.character(trait_value), ""), regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  distinct(species_match_key, trait_group, trait) %>%
  filter(species_match_key %in% unique(focal_species_annotation$species_match_key))

tree_trait_levels <- TMD_TRAITS %>%
  filter(trait %in% unique(tmd_species_traits$trait)) %>%
  pull(trait)

tree_result <- local({
  tree_lineage <- tibble::tibble(
    taxon = make.unique(str_remove(str_extract(species_rows$clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^s__")),
    clade_name = species_rows$clade_name
  ) %>%
    filter(taxon %in% unique(md2_annotation$metaphlan_species))
  tree_parts <- str_split(tree_lineage$clade_name, "\\|")
  stopifnot(all(lengths(tree_parts) == 7L))
  for (i in seq_along(c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus"))) {
    tree_lineage[[c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus")[i]]] <-
      vapply(tree_parts, function(x) str_remove(x[i], "^[kpcofgs]__"), character(1))
  }
  # Each rank name carries its parents, so names repeated under different parents stay separate nodes.
  tree_df <- tree_lineage %>%
    mutate(
      k_ = kingdom,
      p_ = paste(k_, phylum, sep = "/"),
      c_ = paste(p_, class, sep = "/"),
      o_ = paste(c_, order, sep = "/"),
      f_ = paste(o_, family, sep = "/"),
      g_ = paste(f_, genus, sep = "/")
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(c(k_, p_, c_, o_, f_, g_, taxon), factor)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  tax_tree <- ape::as.phylo(~k_/p_/c_/o_/f_/g_/taxon, data = tree_df, collapse = FALSE)
  tax_tree <- ape::collapse.singles(tax_tree)

  PHYLUM_MIN_SPECIES <- 3L
  phylum_counts <- tree_lineage %>% count(phylum, sort = TRUE)
  big_phyla <- phylum_counts %>% filter(n >= PHYLUM_MIN_SPECIES) %>% pull(phylum)
  other_label <- paste0("Other phyla (", sum(!phylum_counts$phylum %in% big_phyla), ")")
  tree_lineage <- tree_lineage %>%
    mutate(phylum_group = factor(if_else(phylum %in% big_phyla, phylum, other_label), levels = c(big_phyla, other_label)))
  PHYLUM_COLORS <- setNames(c(TOL_SAFE[c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7)][seq_along(big_phyla)], "grey45"), levels(tree_lineage$phylum_group))

  tip_groups <- split(as.character(tree_lineage$taxon), tree_lineage$phylum_group)
  tax_tree <- ggtree::groupOTU(tax_tree, tip_groups, group_name = "phylum_group")

  # Ring 1: prevalence in each focal group (percent of samples with the species detected).
  ring_prev <- species_summary %>%
    filter(taxon %in% tree_lineage$taxon) %>%
    transmute(taxon, focal_group = factor(focal_group, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS, labels = unname(FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS[FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS])), prevalence, prevalence_shown = if_else(prevalence > 0, prevalence, NA_real_))
  # Ring 2: every Microbe Directory trait listed for at least one of the 224 matched species.
  tree_trait_group <- TMD_TRAITS %>%
    distinct(trait, trait_group) %>%
    filter(trait %in% tree_trait_levels) %>%
    mutate(trait_group = recode(trait_group, "Surface persistence" = "Surface"))
  ring_trait <- tidyr::crossing(
    tree_lineage %>% transmute(taxon, species_match_key = clean_tmd_species(taxon)),
    trait = tree_trait_levels
  ) %>%
    left_join(tmd_species_traits %>% distinct(species_match_key, trait) %>% mutate(present = TRUE), by = c("species_match_key", "trait")) %>%
    left_join(tree_trait_group, by = "trait") %>%
    mutate(
      trait = factor(trait, levels = tree_trait_levels),
      trait_fill = factor(if_else(!is.na(present), as.character(trait), NA_character_), levels = tree_trait_levels)
    )
  # One colour per trait, in a colour family per trait group (orange: extremophile, green: surface, blue: metabolism).
  TREE_TRAIT_COLORS <- unlist(lapply(c("Extremophile", "Surface", "Metabolism"), function(g) {
    tr <- tree_trait_group$trait[tree_trait_group$trait_group == g]
    tr <- tr[order(match(tr, tree_trait_levels))]
    ends <- switch(g, Extremophile = c("#7F2704", "#FDD49E"), Surface = c("#00441B", "#A1D99B"), Metabolism = c("#08306B", "#9ECAE1"))
    setNames(grDevices::colorRampPalette(ends)(length(tr)), tr)
  }))

  # Ring geometry in inches (print size): tree radius, and one column per focal group or trait.
  # 224 species names set the geometry: the names are read outward from the outer ring, so
  # the rings are kept narrow and the tree small to leave room for them inside 180 mm.
  K <- FIG_BASE_SIZE / 7
  TREE_R_IN <- 1.2
  COL_IN <- 0.045
  GAP_IN <- 0.03
  TREE_LABEL_PT <- 4.5 * K
  TREE_TIP_PT <- 4.5 * K
  TREE_OUTER_R_IN <- 3.05
  n_prev_cols <- length(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS)
  n_trait_cols <- length(tree_trait_levels)
  # ggtreeExtra evaluates the axis settings late, outside this local scope, so they are passed as values.
  tree_axis_params <- list(axis = "x", text.size = pt_to_mm(TREE_LABEL_PT), text.angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, line.size = 0, line.alpha = 0, line.color = NA)
  tree_base <- ggtree::ggtree(tax_tree, layout = "fan", open.angle = 40, branch.length = "none",
                              aes(color = phylum_group), size = gs(0.3), alpha = 0.6)
  tree_depth <- max(tree_base$data$x)
  p_rings <- tree_base +
    scale_color_manual(values = PHYLUM_COLORS, name = "Phylum\n(branch colour)", breaks = names(PHYLUM_COLORS), guide = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 4, override.aes = list(linewidth = gs(2)))) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    rlang::inject(ggtreeExtra::geom_fruit(
      data = ring_prev, geom = geom_point, shape = 22, size = 1.15 * K, stroke = 0, colour = "transparent",
      mapping = aes(y = taxon, x = focal_group, fill = prevalence_shown),
      offset = GAP_IN / TREE_R_IN, pwidth = n_prev_cols * COL_IN / TREE_R_IN,
      axis.params = !!tree_axis_params
    )) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFCC", "#A1DAB4", "#41B6C4", "#225EA8", "#081D58"), limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "transparent", transform = "sqrt", breaks = c(0, 10, 25, 50, 100), name = "Prevalence in\ngroup (%)",
                         guide = guide_colourbar(order = 2, direction = "horizontal", barwidth = unit(by_mode(3.2, 1.6), "cm"), barheight = unit(by_mode(0.55, 0.25), "cm"))) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    rlang::inject(ggtreeExtra::geom_fruit(
      data = ring_trait, geom = geom_point, shape = 22, size = 1.35 * K, stroke = 0, colour = "transparent",
      mapping = aes(y = taxon, x = trait, fill = trait_fill),
      offset = GAP_IN / TREE_R_IN, pwidth = n_trait_cols * COL_IN / TREE_R_IN,
      axis.params = !!tree_axis_params
    )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = TREE_TRAIT_COLORS, na.value = "transparent", name = "Microbe Directory trait", breaks = tree_trait_levels, drop = FALSE,
                      guide = guide_legend(order = 3, nrow = 6, override.aes = list(shape = 22, size = gs(5), colour = "transparent"))) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  # The names start just outside the outer ring. The ring edge is read from the built plot,
  # because ggtreeExtra places the rings in its own units.
  ring_built <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(p_rings)
  # The squares are points, so the edge is the outermost point centre plus half a column.
  ring_edge <- max(vapply(ring_built$data, function(d) if (all(c("x", "shape", "size") %in% names(d))) max(d$x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_, numeric(1)), na.rm = TRUE) +
    tree_depth * COL_IN / TREE_R_IN / 2
  tip_edge <- max(tree_base$data$x)
  label_offset <- ring_edge - tip_edge + tree_depth * GAP_IN / TREE_R_IN
  # Species names, set 4.5 pt (the only text below 5 pt) so 224 names fit one circle.
  p_tree <- p_rings +
    ggtree::geom_tiplab(aes(label = str_replace_all(label, "_", " "), color = NULL), align = TRUE, linesize = 0, offset = label_offset,
                        size = pt_to_mm(TREE_TIP_PT), family = FIG_FONT, fontface = "italic", color = "black") +
    ggtree::xlim_tree(tree_depth * TREE_OUTER_R_IN / TREE_R_IN) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal", legend.box.just = "top", legend.title.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(by_mode(0.5, 0.2), "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE, family = FIG_FONT),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE, family = FIG_FONT),
      legend.key.size = unit(by_mode(0.55, 0.25), "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(0.12 * K, 0.05 * K, 0, 0.05 * K, "in")
    )

  TREE_PAGE_HEIGHT <- 8.6

  tree_table <- tree_lineage %>%
    select(taxon, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus) %>%
    left_join(ring_prev %>% select(taxon, focal_group, prevalence) %>% mutate(focal_group = as.character(focal_group)) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = focal_group, values_from = prevalence, names_prefix = "prevalence_"), by = "taxon") %>%
    left_join(
      ring_trait %>% filter(!is.na(present)) %>% group_by(taxon) %>% summarise(microbe_directory_traits = paste(trait, collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop"),
      by = "taxon"
    ) %>%
    arrange(kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, taxon)
  readr::write_tsv(tree_table, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS6_tree_species.tsv"))

  if (is_print()) {
    tree_files <- save_page(p_tree, OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS6_microbe_directory_tree", height = TREE_PAGE_HEIGHT)
  } else {
    tree_files <- save_panel(p_tree, FIGS6_DIR, "FigureS6_microbe_directory_tree", width = PRINT_WIDTH_IN * K, height = TREE_PAGE_HEIGHT * K)
  }
  list(files = tree_files, phylum_min = PHYLUM_MIN_SPECIES, n_species = nrow(tree_lineage), n_phyla = n_distinct(tree_lineage$phylum), n_traits = length(tree_trait_levels), n_big_phyla = length(big_phyla), n_other = sum(!phylum_counts$phylum %in% big_phyla))
})
knitr::include_graphics(tree_result$files)
```

The tree is a taxonomy dendrogram, not a phylogeny. Its branches follow the MetaPhlAn lineage of each species (kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species), every branch has the same length, and the tips are aligned on the outer circle. It shows which lineages the matched species belong to. It does not show evolutionary distance. Branch color is the phylum. Phyla with fewer than `r tree_result$phylum_min` matched species are pooled into one grey group (`r tree_result$n_other` phyla).

Moving outward from the tree there are two rings of small squares. The inner ring has one column per focal group, in the order Brazil granite, Israel others, Israel rock/stone, United States marble, and United States metal. A square is drawn when the species was detected in that group, and its color is the prevalence, the percent of the group's samples in which it was detected (square-root scale, so low values show). The outer ring has one column per Microbe Directory trait listed for at least one of these species (`r tree_result$n_traits` traits). Pigment producer and UV resistance are not drawn, because no matched species is listed with them. A square means the directory lists that trait for the species. Each trait has its own color, in an orange family for extremophile traits, a green family for surface persistence, and a blue family for metabolism. The branches are drawn thin and pale so the squares carry the figure. Every species is named at its tip, in italics, outside the outer ring. Those names are set at 4.5 pt, the only text in the supplement below the 5 pt minimum, because `r tree_result$n_species` names will not fit around a 180 mm circle at a larger size. The lineage, prevalence in each group, and traits of every species are also listed in `paper_output/FigureS6_tree_species.tsv`, in tree order.

The tree is `paper_output/FigureS6_microbe_directory_tree.pdf` and `paper_output/FigureS6_microbe_directory_tree.png`. The panel is also in `paper_output/FigureS6/`. The table behind it is `paper_output/FigureS6_tree_species.tsv`. The matched Microbe Directory rows are in `paper_output/FigureS6_microbe_directory_annotations.tsv`.

# Supplementary Figure 7. Insertion sequence (IS) elements in the focal groups

```{r figure-sup7, fig.width=14, fig.height=18, out.width="100%"}
FIGS7_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS7")
IS_FILE <- file.path(ROOT, "input", "ISelements_LengthComplFamClusterInfo_UPDATED.xlsx")
# Every inch value below is written for the 180 mm print page. In check mode the same layout
# is drawn at the larger check text size, so all lengths are scaled by the same ratio.
K <- FIG_BASE_SIZE / 7
focal_sample_key_is <- focal_sample_key
is_result <- local({
  # ---- IS table and the IS-cluster matrix (as in MonumentIS.R) -------------------------------
  is_input_table <- readxl::read_excel(IS_FILE)
  ISdat <- is_input_table %>% filter(sample %in% focal_sample_key_is$sample_name_clean)

  cluster_matrix <- ISdat %>%
    select(sample, cluster) %>%
    count(sample, cluster) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
  cluster_matrix <- as.data.frame(cluster_matrix)
  rownames(cluster_matrix) <- cluster_matrix$sample
  cluster_matrix$sample <- NULL
  cluster_matrix <- as.matrix(cluster_matrix)

  # Keep every focal sample with at least one IS cluster (104 of 112).
  keep_samples <- rownames(cluster_matrix)[rowSums(cluster_matrix > 0) >= 1]
  cluster_matrix <- cluster_matrix[keep_samples, colSums(cluster_matrix[keep_samples, , drop = FALSE]) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  ISdat <- ISdat %>% filter(sample %in% keep_samples)

  meta2 <- focal_sample_key_is %>% filter(sample_name_clean %in% rownames(cluster_matrix))
  meta2 <- meta2[match(rownames(cluster_matrix), meta2$sample_name_clean), ]
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(cluster_matrix), meta2$sample_name_clean))

  group_scale_color <- scale_color_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, labels = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS, drop = FALSE, name = "Focal group")
  group_scale_fill <- scale_fill_manual(values = FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS, labels = FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS, drop = FALSE, name = "Focal group")

  # ---- A. Number of IS per sample ------------------------------------------------------------
  cou <- as.data.frame(table(ISdat$sample), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cou_meta <- merge(meta2, cou, by.x = "sample_name_clean", by.y = "Var1")
  cou_meta$focal_group <- factor(cou_meta$focal_group, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS)
  is_count_kw <- kruskal.test(Freq ~ focal_group, data = cou_meta)

  p_a <- ggplot(cou_meta, aes(focal_group, Freq, color = focal_group, fill = focal_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = gs(2.2), alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    group_scale_color + group_scale_fill +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels()) +
    labs(
      tag = "A",
      title = "IS elements per sample",
      subtitle = sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g", is_count_kw$p.value),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of IS elements"
    ) +
    paper_theme_upright() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = by_mode(FIG_BASE_SIZE, 5.5))
    )

  # ---- C. Cluster richness -------------------------------------------------------------------
  alpha_data <- meta2 %>%
    mutate(
      richness = specnumber(cluster_matrix),
      shannon = diversity(cluster_matrix, index = "shannon")
    )
  richness_kw <- kruskal.test(richness ~ focal_group, data = alpha_data)
  p_c <- ggplot(alpha_data, aes(focal_group, richness, color = focal_group, fill = focal_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = gs(2.2), alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    group_scale_color + group_scale_fill +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels()) +
    labs(
      tag = "C",
      title = "IS cluster richness",
      subtitle = sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g", richness_kw$p.value),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of IS clusters"
    ) +
    paper_theme_upright() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = by_mode(FIG_BASE_SIZE, 5.5))
    )

  # ---- B. UpSet plot: IS clusters shared between focal groups --------------------------------
  pa_matrix <- cluster_matrix > 0
  group_matrix <- sapply(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS, function(g) {
    colSums(pa_matrix[meta2$focal_group == g, , drop = FALSE]) > 0
  })
  colnames(group_matrix) <- unname(FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS[FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS])
  group_matrix <- as.data.frame(group_matrix)

  # ComplexUpset (used in MonumentIS.R) does not run with the installed ggplot2 4.x, so the
  # plot is drawn with ggplot directly, in inch coordinates like Figure 6B: one bar per exact
  # combination of groups, a dot matrix below it, and the number of clusters in each group on
  # the left. The intersection bars use a log10 axis, because the counts run from 1 to tens of
  # thousands and the linear scale would hide every shared set; each bar is labelled with its
  # exact count.
  up_sets <- unname(FOCAL_LEGEND_LABELS[FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS])
  up_pattern <- apply(as.matrix(group_matrix[, up_sets]) + 0L, 1, paste, collapse = "")
  up_combos <- tibble(pattern = up_pattern) %>%
    count(pattern, name = "n_clusters") %>%
    mutate(degree = str_count(pattern, "1")) %>%
    filter(degree > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_clusters), desc(degree), pattern) %>%
    mutate(combo = row_number())
  n_cols <- nrow(up_combos)
  n_rows <- length(up_sets)
  up_membership <- tidyr::crossing(combo = up_combos$combo, set_index = seq_len(n_rows)) %>%
    left_join(up_combos, by = "combo") %>%
    mutate(member = substr(pattern, set_index, set_index) == "1")
  up_links <- up_membership %>%
    filter(member) %>%
    group_by(combo) %>%
    summarise(y_min = min(set_index), y_max = max(set_index), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(y_max > y_min)
  up_set_sizes <- tibble(set_index = seq_len(n_rows), n_clusters = colSums(group_matrix[, up_sets]))

  # Layout in inches
  UP_ROW_H <- 0.2 * K
  UP_SIZE_W <- 0.95 * K
  UP_NAMES_W <- 1.25 * K
  UP_TOP_H <- 1.35 * K
  up_sizes_x0 <- 0.55 * K + UP_SIZE_W                      # right end of the set-size bars
  up_matrix_x0 <- up_sizes_x0 + 0.12 * K + UP_NAMES_W + 0.08 * K
  UP_COL_W <- min(0.32 * K, (PRINT_WIDTH_IN * K - up_matrix_x0 - 0.1 * K) / n_cols)
  up_matrix_x1 <- up_matrix_x0 + n_cols * UP_COL_W
  up_matrix_y0 <- 0.75 * K
  up_matrix_y1 <- up_matrix_y0 + n_rows * UP_ROW_H
  up_top_base <- up_matrix_y1 + 0.12 * K
  up_width <- up_matrix_x1 + 0.1 * K
  up_height <- up_top_base + UP_TOP_H + 0.5 * K

  col_x <- function(i) up_matrix_x0 + (i - 0.5) * UP_COL_W
  row_y <- function(j) up_matrix_y0 + (j - 0.5) * UP_ROW_H
  # first group on top
  row_of <- function(set_index) n_rows + 1 - set_index
  log_floor <- 0.5                                       # the bar axis starts at 0.5 clusters
  top_h <- function(n) UP_TOP_H * log10(n / log_floor) / log10(max(up_combos$n_clusters) / log_floor)
  top_ticks <- 10^(0:floor(log10(max(up_combos$n_clusters))))
  size_scale <- UP_SIZE_W / max(up_set_sizes$n_clusters)
  size_ticks <- c(0, 0.5, 1) * 10^floor(log10(max(up_set_sizes$n_clusters)))
  size_ticks <- size_ticks[size_ticks <= max(up_set_sizes$n_clusters)]
  up_text <- pt_to_mm(FIG_BASE_SIZE)
  up_small <- pt_to_mm(FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE)
  top_axis_x <- up_matrix_x0 - 0.06 * K
  size_axis_y <- up_matrix_y0 - 0.07 * K
  fmt <- function(v) format(v, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

  p_b <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(
      data = tibble(j = seq(1, n_rows, by = 2)),
      aes(xmin = up_matrix_x0 - 0.03 * K, xmax = up_matrix_x1, ymin = row_y(j) - UP_ROW_H / 2, ymax = row_y(j) + UP_ROW_H / 2),
      fill = "grey94"
    ) +
    # dot matrix: grey = not in the combination, group color = in it
    geom_point(data = up_membership, aes(col_x(combo), row_y(row_of(set_index))), colour = "grey80", size = gs(4)) +
    geom_segment(data = up_links, aes(x = col_x(combo), xend = col_x(combo), y = row_y(row_of(y_max)), yend = row_y(row_of(y_min))), linewidth = gs(1.4), colour = "grey15") +
    geom_point(
      data = filter(up_membership, member),
      aes(col_x(combo), row_y(row_of(set_index))),
      colour = unname(FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS[FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS])[filter(up_membership, member)$set_index],
      size = gs(5)
    ) +
    geom_text(data = tibble(j = seq_len(n_rows), label = rev(up_sets)), aes(x = up_matrix_x0 - 0.1 * K, y = row_y(j), label = label), hjust = 1, size = up_text) +
    # intersection bars (log10 axis)
    geom_rect(
      data = up_combos,
      aes(xmin = col_x(combo) - 0.7 * UP_COL_W / 2, xmax = col_x(combo) + 0.7 * UP_COL_W / 2, ymin = up_top_base, ymax = up_top_base + top_h(n_clusters)),
      fill = "grey25"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = up_combos,
      aes(x = col_x(combo), y = up_top_base + top_h(n_clusters) + 0.03 * K, label = fmt(n_clusters)),
      angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = up_small
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x = top_axis_x, xend = top_axis_x, y = up_top_base, yend = up_top_base + UP_TOP_H, linewidth = gs(0.5)) +
    annotate("segment", x = top_axis_x - 0.05 * K, xend = top_axis_x, y = up_top_base + top_h(top_ticks), yend = up_top_base + top_h(top_ticks), linewidth = gs(0.5)) +
    annotate("text", x = top_axis_x - 0.08 * K, y = up_top_base + top_h(top_ticks), label = fmt(top_ticks), hjust = 1, size = up_small) +
    annotate("text", x = top_axis_x - (0.08 + 0.33 + 0.09) * K, y = up_top_base + UP_TOP_H / 2, label = "Shared IS clusters\n(log scale)",
             angle = 90, vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = pt_to_mm(FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE), lineheight = 0.95) +
    # set-size bars (linear axis)
    geom_rect(
      data = up_set_sizes,
      aes(xmin = up_sizes_x0 - n_clusters * size_scale, xmax = up_sizes_x0, ymin = row_y(row_of(set_index)) - UP_ROW_H * 0.3, ymax = row_y(row_of(set_index)) + UP_ROW_H * 0.3),
      fill = unname(FOCAL_GROUP_COLORS[FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS])
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = up_set_sizes,
      aes(x = up_sizes_x0 - n_clusters * size_scale - 0.03 * K, y = row_y(row_of(set_index)), label = fmt(n_clusters)),
      hjust = 1, size = up_small
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x = up_sizes_x0 - max(size_ticks) * size_scale, xend = up_sizes_x0, y = size_axis_y, yend = size_axis_y, linewidth = gs(0.5)) +
    annotate("segment", x = up_sizes_x0 - size_ticks * size_scale, xend = up_sizes_x0 - size_ticks * size_scale, y = size_axis_y, yend = size_axis_y - 0.05 * K, linewidth = gs(0.5)) +
    annotate("text", x = up_sizes_x0 - size_ticks * size_scale, y = size_axis_y - 0.08 * K, label = fmt(size_ticks), vjust = 1, size = up_small) +
    annotate("text", x = up_sizes_x0 - UP_SIZE_W / 2, y = size_axis_y - (0.08 + 0.12 + 0.07) * K, label = "IS clusters per group", vjust = 1, hjust = 0.5, size = pt_to_mm(FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE)) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.02 * K, y = up_height - 0.04 * K, label = "B", hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = pt_to_mm(FIG_TAG_SIZE)) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.3 * K, y = up_height - 0.05 * K, label = "IS clusters shared between focal groups", hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = pt_to_mm(FIG_TITLE_SIZE)) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, up_width), ylim = c(0, up_height), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

  # ---- D. Alpha diversity: Shannon (settings of Figure 2D) -----------------------------------
  shannon_kw <- kruskal.test(shannon ~ focal_group, data = alpha_data)

  p_d <- ggplot(alpha_data, aes(focal_group, shannon, color = focal_group, fill = focal_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = gs(2.2), alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    group_scale_color + group_scale_fill +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = focal_axis_labels()) +
    labs(
      tag = "D",
      title = "Shannon diversity of IS clusters",
      subtitle = sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g", shannon_kw$p.value),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Shannon diversity"
    ) +
    paper_theme_upright() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = by_mode(FIG_BASE_SIZE, 5.5))
    )

  # ---- E. Beta diversity: Jaccard NMDS + PERMANOVA (settings of Figure 2E) -------------------
  is_beta <- jaccard_beta(
    cluster_matrix,
    meta2$focal_group,
    nperm = N_PERMUTATIONS,
    seed = RANDOM_SEED
  )
  permanova <- is_beta$permanova
  nmds_data <- meta2 %>%
    inner_join(tibble::rownames_to_column(is_beta$scores, "sample_name_clean"), by = "sample_name_clean")

  p_e <- ggplot(nmds_data, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = focal_group)) +
    geom_point(size = gs(3), alpha = 0.85) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = focal_group), level = ELLIPSE_LEVEL, linewidth = gs(0.8), show.legend = FALSE) +
    group_scale_color +
    labs(
      tag = "E",
      title = "Jaccard NMDS of IS clusters",
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "n = %d; stress = %.3f\nPERMANOVA R2 = %.3f, %s",
        is_beta$n_samples, is_beta$stress, permanova$R2[1], perm_p_text(permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1])
      ),
      x = "NMDS1",
      y = "NMDS2"
    ) +
    paper_theme_continuous() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")


  group_legend_src <- ggplot(tibble(focal_group = factor(FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS), x = 1, y = 1), aes(x, y, color = focal_group)) +
    geom_point(size = gs(6)) +
    group_scale_color +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = gs(5.5)))) +
    theme_void(base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE),
          legend.text = element_text(size = FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE), legend.key.size = unit(0.3 * K, "cm"))
  focal_legend <- blk(cowplot::get_legend(group_legend_src))

  is_page_heights <- c(2.55, up_height / K, 2.7, 0.35)
  figure_is <- (
    (blk(p_a) | blk(p_c) | blk(p_d)) /
    blk(p_b) /
    blk(p_e) /
    focal_legend
  ) + plot_layout(heights = is_page_heights)

  # Check mode: one PNG per panel. Print mode: the combined A4 page.
  if (!is_print()) {
    is_files <- c(
      save_panel(p_a + theme(legend.position = "none"), FIGS7_DIR, "FigureS7A_is_per_sample", width = 3.0 * K, height = 3.2 * K),
      save_panel(p_b, FIGS7_DIR, "FigureS7B_is_cluster_upset", width = up_width, height = up_height),
      save_panel(p_c + theme(legend.position = "none"), FIGS7_DIR, "FigureS7C_is_richness", width = 3.0 * K, height = 3.2 * K),
      save_panel(p_d, FIGS7_DIR, "FigureS7D_is_shannon", width = 3.5 * K, height = 3.3 * K),
      save_panel(p_e + theme(legend.position = "bottom"), FIGS7_DIR, "FigureS7E_is_jaccard_nmds", width = 3.59 * K, height = 3.3 * K + 0.8)
    )
  } else {
    is_files <- save_page(figure_is, OUTPUT_DIR, "FigureS7_is_elements", height = sum(is_page_heights))
  }

  list(
    files = is_files,
    n_elements_input = nrow(is_input_table),
    n_samples_input = n_distinct(is_input_table$sample),
    n_samples_used = nrow(cluster_matrix),
    n_elements_used = nrow(ISdat),
    n_clusters_used = ncol(cluster_matrix),
    n_clusters_shared = sum(rowSums(group_matrix) >= 2),
    p_count = is_count_kw$p.value,
    p_richness = richness_kw$p.value,
    p_shannon = shannon_kw$p.value,
    n_nmds = is_beta$n_samples,
    nmds_stress = is_beta$stress,
    permanova_r2 = permanova$R2[1],
    permanova_p = permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
})
knitr::include_graphics(is_result$files)
```

This figure summarizes the IS elements called in the assemblies, from `input/ISelements_LengthComplFamClusterInfo_UPDATED.xlsx` (`r is_result$n_elements_input` IS elements in `r is_result$n_samples_input` samples). The samples are the focal-group samples of the main figures (positive and negative controls removed, at least two detected species). Every focal sample with at least one IS cluster is kept. This leaves `r is_result$n_samples_used` samples and `r format(is_result$n_elements_used, big.mark = ",")` IS elements in `r format(is_result$n_clusters_used, big.mark = ",")` clusters. The three Tel Megiddo `control` swabs are kept, as in the main figures. PAIS-NN ecosystem assignments are in Figure 4.

A shows the number of IS elements per sample (Kruskal-Wallis p = `r signif(is_result$p_count, 3)`). B is an UpSet plot of the IS clusters shared between groups. `r format(is_result$n_clusters_shared, big.mark = ",")` of the `r format(is_result$n_clusters_used, big.mark = ",")` clusters occur in two or more groups. The intersection bars use a log10 axis, because the counts run from one to tens of thousands, and each bar is labeled with its exact count. ComplexUpset, used in `Script/MonumentIS.R`, does not run with the installed ggplot2 4.x, so the plot is drawn directly in ggplot. C is IS cluster richness per sample (Kruskal-Wallis p = `r signif(is_result$p_richness, 3)`). D is the Shannon diversity of IS clusters (Kruskal-Wallis p = `r signif(is_result$p_shannon, 3)`). E is a Jaccard NMDS of cluster presence or absence. Clusters found in only one sample are omitted, as in Figure 2, so the NMDS does not collapse; that leaves `r is_result$n_nmds` of the `r is_result$n_samples_used` samples. 75% ellipses and 999 permutations for PERMANOVA (stress = `r round(is_result$nmds_stress, 3)`, R2 = `r round(is_result$permanova_r2, 3)`, `r perm_p_text(is_result$permanova_p)`). The seed is `r RANDOM_SEED`.

The combined figure is `paper_output/FigureS7_is_elements.pdf` and `paper_output/FigureS7_is_elements.png`. Panels A to E are also in `paper_output/FigureS7/`.

The figures above are the check panels: each panel is saved on its own, large, in `paper_output/FigureS1/` to `paper_output/FigureS7/`.
